text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If only I could've pushed forward just one more step...
Maybe then, I would've been in the lead—...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: No, anything more would just be making excuses. I have to do everything I can 'right now.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"One's full strength is not meant to be used for destruction
—it is meant to be used to shine."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "For now, I'd like to work out the ideal coordination for the next race."
choice_data_list: I'm going to be strict with training, too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "For now, I'd like to work out the ideal coordination for the next race."
choice_data_list: I'm going to be strict with training, too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Please join us as well, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Let's find the absolute best outfit
together!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's just what I was hoping for!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"As long as 'I' am 'myself,'
victory is something I must seize with this very body!"
